source.title: О некоторых проблемах теории дифференциальных уравнений

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 3822296.
Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/3822296 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, classified as blocked_or_challenged.

The zbMATH REST API identified the exact work as Samarskij, A. A., Some problems in differential equation theory, Differential Equations 16, 1221-1228 (1981), translated from Differentsialnye Uravneniya 16, 1925-1935 (1980), document id 3822296. API metadata was used only for identity resolution.

Exact-title recovery found the Math-Net page https://www.mathnet.ru/rus/de4116 for the Russian original О некоторых проблемах теории дифференциальных уравнений with a full-text PDF. The PDF was downloaded to /home/gson/paper-question-parser/.sisyphus/paper-question-parser/tmp/3822296.pdf using the Math-Net full-text endpoint.

The recovered PDF could not be converted to text with the available local shell tool path because pdftotext failed before execution with: bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted. Without page-located verbatim source text, candidate extraction and evidence-grounded rewriting cannot be performed.
No accepted questions were emitted because the evidence coverage and evidence completeness gates require verbatim source quotes with page numbers.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3822296.json and outputs/latest.json.
